model.name: R19.22.B: UI link next to the edit pencil button that opens the canonical Room scenario unit.
model.description: UI affordance: a clickable link (icon or text) adjacent to the room edit pencil button that navigates to the canonical Room scenario unit in the /trace tree or scenario viewer. Enables the user to inspect the room's scenario data directly from the room UI.
model.refinementOfNote: Split from R19.22 per PO decision 2026-06-10: R19.22.A = filesystem invariant; R19.22.B = UI affordance (link to canonical unit next to edit pencil).
